name: Volkstheater
notes: WP admin-ajax action=ajax_load_events (POST start_date/end_date unix ts + load_future_events=true) returns {events: <html fragment>, end_date, has_future}; loop extending end_date until has_future is falsy. Site is in summer break so listing naturally starts ~Sept 10 (no filtering needed for that); publishes real dates out to ~May 2027 (has_future goes falsy after ~4 pages), well beyond the 180d horizon. category only set for ~1/4 of events (Premiere/Wiederaufnahme/etc, verbatim); price_min parsed from the price-info div only (ticket-col presale text like 'Tickets ab 7.9.2026' was excluded after it corrupted price parsing by matching the year as a price - only used ticket-col text for the free-entry case).
